demo.title: defi-native.txt
demo.code:
You: I found a 7% USDC vault, is it safe? It's on Morpho.

Agent (with defi-native): Refuses 'safe'. Names the five vault layers,
walks the claim stack on three surfaces (chain, the vault's own
transparency page, docs), finds the collateral is mostly wrapped BTC
and a synthetic dollar, names the oracle class per market and whether
liquidations fire on a visible tape, splits base from incentives with
as-of dates, points at first loss, and runs risk:reward including the
total-loss branch. Read-only: it analyzes, it never signs.

# Live data, keyless:
python3 scripts/pulse.py yields USDC morpho-blue
python3 scripts/pulse.py stablecoins

setup: No keys required: DefiLlama, Morpho GraphQL, Merkl, GeckoTerminal, and CoinGecko recipes are keyless
Optional depth: see the bring-your-own-keys table in references/data-sources.md (vaults.fyi, Dune, FRED)
Canonical repo and updates: https://github.com/emlai/defi-native-skill (the skill checks its own version each session)
